verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents Kimi connecting to a user's cloud drive, email, or calendar so the assistant can search or use them in answers. The help index mentions plugins and skills, and Kimi Claw connecting to Feishu, but neither describes drive, email, or calendar data connectors. That is adjacent material at best and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can connect my cloud drive, email, and calendar so the assistant can search and use them in answers
